title: Billing & Data Administrator
description:
£30,000 - £35,000 DOE
Billing Administrator Location: Stamford Hill Hours: Fully office-based role
Monday - Thursday: 9:30am - 6:00pm
Friday: Early finish (in winter months)

Are you good with data and MS Excel? If you answered yes, we want to hear from you!
Box Recruitment Solutions are exclusively recruiting for a growing telecoms business in Stamford Hill. Reporting directly to the Billing Manager, this is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and detail-oriented administrator with strong data handling and customer service skills to join a busy and supportive finance and operations team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out billing administration for both B2 B and B2 C customers across telecoms services including landline, broadband, leased lines and mobile services.

Key Responsibilities
- Billing & Data Administration
- Monthly billing administration for B2 B and B2 C customers
- Dealing with customer billing queries over the phone and resolving
- Add and organise data within the billing system
- Monitor and report billing data using internal systems
- Reconcile and validate discrepancies across platforms including Zoho, Salesstar, My Accounts and Abillity
- Import, match and verify data from multiple sources
- Customer Communications
- Generate and send end-of-contract letters to customers
- Handle customer and internal queries via email and telephone professionally
- Produce and dispatch billing and account-related correspondence
- Systems & Reporting
- Work with the Abillity billing platform
- Produce internal reports and compile team data for review
- Support the transition from manual to system-led billing processes
- Team Support
- Work closely within a collaborative team environment
- Support colleagues with ad hoc administrative and operational tasks
- Participate in cross-functional communication across the business

Preferred Skills & Experience
- Confident Excel skills including formulas and pivot tables
- Previous billing administration or data-driven administration experience (preferred)
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Professional and confident telephone manner
- Able to commute to Stamford Hill North London on a daily basis
- Exposure to billing and CRM systems such as Abillity, Zoho, Salesstar or similar billing platforms would be advantageous

Benefits
- 28 days holiday
- Private healthcare
- Discretionary yearly bonus
- KPI bonus scheme
- Discounted rewards scheme
- Early finish on Fridays

title: Operations Administrator
description:
Operations Administrator

When registering to this job board you will be redirected to the online application form. Please ensure that this is completed in full in order that your application can be reviewed.

Join Our Operations Team

We're looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Operations Administrator to support the smooth running of our production operation. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working closely with production, planning, and quality teams.

As an Operations Administrator, you'll play a vital role in ensuring production systems are accurate, operational data is up to date, and key information is communicated effectively across the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Allocate the correct stock to production lines using business systems and ensure production line screens are prepared for label printing.
- Generate production orders for all operational departments.
- Support the Production Planning team as required, including providing planning cover when needed.
- Produce comprehensive end-of-shift handover reports for the incoming shift and management team.
- Monitor data accuracy across operational systems, investigate discrepancies, and report findings.
- Review and close completed production orders, working with production teams to resolve any issues.
- Provide Quality Assurance with details of amber and red-rated production runs for shift reporting.
- Update operational dashboards and distribute daily production performance reports.
- Print product and date labels to support production requirements.
- Monitor production system performance throughout the shift, identifying and helping resolve issues before production runs are completed.
- Maintain and update production performance records throughout the day.
- Provide administrative support across the Operations function as required.

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll have:

Essential
- A good standard of written and spoken English.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook, Excel, and database systems.
- Previous experience in an administrative role.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work accurately under pressure.
- The ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable
- Experience working within an FMCG or food manufacturing environment.
- Previous experience supporting production planning or scheduling activities.

You will receive:
- Company sick pay
- Transport available from the city centre
- Opportunity for overtime and overtime bonuses
- Life assurance cover
- Critical illness cover
- Health and well-being initiatives
- Free potatoes
- Online store discounts scheme
- Free onsite parking
- Career development opportunities

description:
Sales & Customer Service AdvisorBoston, Lincolnshire

27-29,000 + Annual Bonus

If you're the sort of person who enjoys speaking with customers, spotting opportunities and building relationships, this could be exactly what you're looking for.

We're working with a well-established international business that is investing in the future of its sales function and looking to strengthen its internal sales team with proactive, commercially minded people who want to make an impact.

This is not a traditional customer service role. You'll be working closely with an established customer base across the UK, supporting enquiries, processing orders and delivering excellent service, whilst also identifying opportunities to upsell, cross-sell and promote new products and special offers. The customers already know the business, so this is about building relationships, adding value and helping to drive growth rather than cold calling.

You'll work alongside external sales colleagues, manage customer relationships of your own and become a trusted point of contact for customers across a variety of sectors. It's an opportunity to join a business that wants its internal sales team to play a bigger role commercially and is looking for people who can help lead that change.

What we're looking for
- Customer service, internal sales, account support or retail sales experience
- Confidence speaking with customers over the phone
- A proactive and positive approach
- Strong relationship-building skills
- The ability to spot opportunities and act on them
- Good IT and organisational skills
- A desire to learn, develop and progress

What's on offer?
- 27-29,000 salary
- Annual bonus of up to 5%
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm
- Ongoing training and development
- Employee discounts and wellbeing benefits
- Cycle to Work scheme
- Free on-site parking

This is a great opportunity for somebody who wants to move beyond reactive customer service and become part of a team where commercial thinking, relationship building and initiative are genuinely valued.

title: Business Ventures Administrator
description:
Are you a highly organised administrator ready to be the operational heart of a growing business ventures team? South Ormsby Estate has an exciting Business Ventures Administrator opportunity!

Location: South Ormsby Estate, Lincolnshire Wolds, LN11 8 QS

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full - Time, Permanent

About Us:

South Ormsby Estate is creating one of the UK's most ambitious rural business communities. With a vision to establish over 500 thriving businesses across the Estate, we are transforming how rural enterprise operates. This is a pivotal moment to join a growing organisation delivering significant commercial and community impact.

The village of South Ormsby is an estate of c 3000 acres nestled within the Lincolnshire Wolds and is an area of outstanding natural beauty, rich in wildlife. The custodians of the South Ormsby Estate are restoring the heritage of the estate and rejuvenating the local economy.

Building upon a historic past and using the latest technology their vision is to create the best place to invest, work, live, play and retire to. In short, the aim is to create the best farming estate in the world.

Business Ventures Administrator - The Role:

You will be the operational hub of the Business Ventures department, managing the complete customer journey from initial enquiry through to signed agreement. You will lead the Lead Interaction Team, qualify incoming business opportunities, administer every stage of our process, and maintain accurate records throughout. This role demands exceptional organisation, attention to detail, and excellent communication to ensure every enquiry receives professional and consistent handling.

Business Ventures Administrator - Key Responsibilities:
- Manage the Lead Interaction Team and ensure all incoming enquiries receive prompt responses
- Qualify every Business Ventures enquiry and allocate opportunities to appropriate team members
- Maintain accurate CRM records, monitor pipeline progression, and produce weekly reports covering leads, pipeline status, agreements and contracts
- Prepare and issue Heads of Terms, manage tenancy agreement administration, and coordinate commercial contracts and documentation
- Monitor every opportunity through each pipeline stage, chase outstanding information from applicants, and identify process bottlenecks

Business Ventures Administrator - You:
- Demonstrate excellent administrative and organisational skills with outstanding attention to detail
- Have strong experience using CRM systems and are highly proficient in Microsoft Office
- Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
- Show a process-driven approach, calm under pressure, and passionate commitment to delivering outstanding customer service

Benefits:
- They are creating more than just a place to work, with big plans for the estate and everyone involved with their vision to become the best farming estate in the world
- Employee discount on all Estate products

To submit your CV for this exciting Business Ventures Administrator opportunity, click Apply today!

title: Engagement Administrator
company: Road Safety Markings Association - Company - Permanent
description:
Engagement Administrator

Location: Gainsborough, Lincolnshire

Salary: Starting salary of £24,500 per annum (36.5 hours per week)

Vacancy Type: Permanent or Fixed Term, Full Time or Part Time available

ABOUT US

The Road Safety Markings Association (RSMA) is one of the largest specialist trade bodies in the Highways sector and plays a pivotal role in the development of the UK road marking industry.

We are a small, dynamic trade association dedicated to representing and supporting our members through advocacy, networking, events, and communications. With a collaborative team environment, we provide opportunities for learning, growth, and meaningful contribution to the industry. It is our aim to promote our industry as a key component of a safe and effective highways network.

ABOUT YOU

We are seeking a proactive and enthusiastic Engagement Administrator to join our team.

The successful candidate will be confident and competent to support communications, event coordination, manage records to support member engagement and relations, and manage day-to-day office administration.

THE JOB ROLE

This administrative role supports the activities of the membership and marketing team at the RSMA. This includes liaising with stakeholders and external clients, ensuring alignment with organisational objectives.

As an Engagement Administrator you will develop and maintain good relationships with all team members and RSMA stakeholders.

This position is office-based in Gainsborough, Lincolnshire.

This is a new role created as our team grows, and we are looking for the right person to join us. We can be flexible with working arrangements, including full-time or part-time hours and either a permanent or fixed-term contract. Please tell us what would work best for you in your application.

On occasion, the role may involve travelling throughout the UK at various times of the year to represent the RSMA and our sector at highways industry events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Deliver effective administration of RSMA membership.
- Provide relevant information for all enquiries in a timely manner.
- Support in the administration of all membership management, engagement and events.
- Ensure the administration of all membership and events activities follow organisational procedures.
- Support the Marketing and Events Assistant with external events and the RSMA's Annual Conference and Dinner.
- Support the organisation of stakeholder forums and internal events.
- Organise member engagement visits for the CEO and any other ad-hoc meetings.
- Foster open communication, and promote a culture of preparedness, innovation, financial awareness, and accountability in support of all work delivered.
- Manage office administration (i.e. checking stock and ordering consumables, troubleshooting any building maintenance issues).
- Develop own professional capability to support planned organisational growth.
- Support the overall aim of the organisation, taking on role relevant activities when required.
- Work with RSMA colleagues to support RSMA member organisations.

ESSENTIAL
- Able to manage administration tasks.
- Ability to maintain stakeholder relationships.
- Excellent ICT skills and experience, including MS-365 and CRM systems.
- Able to support the development of administrative systems.
- Experienced in scheduling workloads and time management.
- Excellent communication skills, oral and written.
- Capable of prioritising workloads and adapting to a fluctuating work volume environment.
- Commit to attendance at RSMA annual conference, including associated nights away from home.
- Comfortable with occasional travel and overnight stays to industry related events in support of RSMA members and road safety marking sector interests.

DESIRABLE
- Experienced in administration within an Association or membership organisation.
- Own car, UK driving licence to category B, and business car insurance.
- Experience in or knowledge of marketing and events basics.
- Experience in or knowledge of the road marking or other highways construction sector.

WHAT WE WILL OFFER YOU
- An exciting opportunity to work for a well-established and respected Trade Association.
- A starting salary of £24,500 for full time (36.5 hours a week), pro rata for part time (negotiable for the right candidate).
- A benefits package including private health cover and generous annual holiday allocation.
- Standard office working hours, with some exceptions where travel to events would be required, but these will be well planned.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Road Safety Markings Association, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Pride in Place Programme Coordinator for Immingham
description:
Pride in Place Programme Co-ordinator for Immingham
Hosted by Oasis Community Partnerships, working for the towns of Immingham & Habrough
Hours: Full Time (40 hours per week)
Contract Type: Fixed Term (subject to programme funding)
Salary: Grade B Salary - £42,752.00 (dependent on experience and qualifications)

Would you like to help shape the future of Immingham?
Would you like to lead a transformational programme driven by local people?

Would you like to bring together residents, businesses and partners to create lasting place-based change?

Oasis are excited to be able to host this role as part of the Pride in Place Programme for Immingham and Habrough. Pride in Place is a significant Government investment designed to empower local communities to shape and deliver a long-term vision for their area. Working with residents, businesses, public services, elected members and local organisations, the programme seeks to build stronger communities, improve local places and create opportunities for future generations.

The programme is seeking an ambitious, experienced and highly organised Programme Co-ordinator to lead the delivery of the Pride in Place Programme in Immingham & Habrough . This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in coordinating a community-led regeneration programme, ensuring local voices are at the heart of decision making and helping to create a lasting legacy for the area.

The successful candidate will provide visible place leadership, supporting the Neighbourhood Board to develop and deliver a 10-year Regeneration Plan and a 4-year Investment Plan. They will oversee programme governance, stakeholder engagement, project management, financial monitoring and compliance with government funding requirements.

Key responsibilities include:
- Coordinating the development and submission of the Pride in Place 10-Year Regeneration Plan and 4-Year Investment Plan.
- Supporting and servicing the Neighbourhood Board, including governance, reporting and administration.
- Acting as a Place Leader, fostering collaboration across communities, organisations and sectors.
- Managing programme delivery, ensuring compliance with Government guidance and funding requirements.
- Leading community engagement activities and ensuring residents are central to programme development.
- Developing project plans, risk registers, reporting systems and performance monitoring frameworks.
- Supporting procurement processes and the commissioning of consultants, contractors and delivery partners.
- Managing budgets, financial reporting and audit requirements in partnership with the local authority.
- Building and maintaining productive relationships with government departments, local authorities, community organisations and other stakeholders.
- Acting as an ambassador for the programme and championing local aspirations.

The successful post holder must have:
- A degree-level qualification, professional qualification (Level 4-5) or equivalent relevant experience.
- Significant experience of leading complex programmes, projects or partnerships.
- Experience of stakeholder engagement, partnership working and community consultation.
- Strong programme and project management skills, including risk management and reporting.
- Experience of budget management and financial accountability.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence a wide range of stakeholders.
- Knowledge of grant-funded programmes and governance processes.
- The ability to analyse complex information and develop practical solutions.
- A commitment to inclusion, community participation and the Oasis ethos and values.
- Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends when required.

As part of the package, Oasis offers:
- A pension scheme offering a 7% employer contribution.
- A generous holiday allowance, starting at 25 days per year (plus 8 Bank Holidays).
- Policies which promote wellbeing and are family friendly.
- Opportunities for professional development and training.
- The chance to make a meaningful difference within local communities.
